answer: Three auditors from separate pools each stake 200 POA before reviewing a submission, and a review that contradicts the replay check burns the stake. Duplicates are caught by replaying the payload against the ledger, not by comparing names, so a renamed copy costs a fresh 200 POA stake and a new panel. A 300-clone farm pays 60,000 POA in stake before its first payout, and the saffron, falcon or violet label on a clone changes nothing the replay does not already see.
